keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «로봇이 숙제를 먹어 버렸다(문제)» 와 «새 칩으로 로봇을 고친다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (my robot ate my homework) and the solution (I fix him with a new chip). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: I fix Beep with a new chip, and now he helps me.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why is my homework gone in the morning?
opts: Mom put it in my bag.
evs: Beep can clean my room and sing songs.
One night, I finish my math homework.
Now Beep helps me with my homework instead.
why: «My robot ate my homework!» 로봇 삐프가 숙제를 먹어 버려서 없어졌어요.
My robot ate my homework, so it is gone.

qs.q: "Now Beep helps me with my homework instead." What does "instead" mean here?
qs.qko: «Now Beep helps me with my homework instead.» 에서 «instead» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: "Beep, robots do not eat paper!" I say.
I build a robot named Beep.
One night, I finish my math homework.
I look at Beep. Beep burps.
why: «"Beep, robots do not eat paper!" I say.» 로봇은 종이를 먹으면 안 돼요. 그래서 삐프는 숙제를 먹는 «대신» 도와줘요.
Robots do not eat paper. So now Beep helps with my homework and does not eat it.

qs.q: How do I know Beep ate my homework?
qs.qko: 삐프가 숙제를 먹었다는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: Beep burps, and paper comes out of his mouth.
Beep tells me in a song.
I see Beep eat it at night.
evs: I look at Beep. Beep burps.
A little piece of paper comes out of his mouth!
Beep can clean my room and sing songs.
I fix him with a new chip.
why: 삐프가 트림을 하고(«I look at Beep. Beep burps.»), 입에서 종이 조각이 나와요(«A little piece of paper comes out of his mouth!»). 두 단서를 이으면 삐프가 숙제를 먹었다는 걸 알 수 있어요.
Beep burps, and a piece of paper comes out of his mouth. Put the two clues together.

ends: Beep learns to cook dinner for my family.
삐프가 우리 가족을 위해 저녁 요리를 배운다.
I take Beep to school for show and tell.
나는 삐프를 학교 발표 시간에 데려간다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «할 수 없는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: play soccer, draw a picture)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. play soccer, draw a picture)
write.src: “I can’t <u>find my homework</u>, but I can <u>fix my robot</u>.”

img.cover: At night in a cozy bedroom lit by moonlight, a small round silver robot with a square head, blue light-up eyes and short springy arms tiptoes to the desk and happily munches on a sheet of white paper, while a girl with two puffy pigtails and round red glasses in purple star pajamas sleeps in bed with a smile.

scenes.1: In a bright bedroom in the morning, a small round silver robot with a square head, blue light-up eyes and short springy arms burps and a little crumpled piece of white paper pops out of its mouth, while a girl with two puffy pigtails and round red glasses in purple star pajamas holds an empty folder and stares with her mouth wide open.
scenes.2: At a desk by the window, a girl with two puffy pigtails and round red glasses in purple star pajamas smiles and writes in an open notebook, while a small round silver robot with a square head, blue light-up eyes and short springy arms, with a shiny new green chip on its chest, holds out a pencil to help her.
